mechanism.base: Earth gives water its shape, the old texts say. Banks on either side, a bed beneath, and the river goes somewhere instead of everywhere. Without ground to press against, water spreads thin across the land and soaks away into nothing. The bank pushes, and the current answers by running deeper. That pressure turns a flood into a river, and a river into a road that reaches the sea.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: With too little Earth, the water has no banks to push against. It spreads wide and shallow and arrives nowhere. Answer to one deadline you did not set, and keep it.
mechanism.friction_turn: With too much Earth, the banks press in until the water barely moves. Every rule you meet turns into a judge of you. Read one slow book before the next demand.

function.definition_catalyst: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Earth makes it steady, a rule that stays once you agree. As a catalyst, the frame runs thin. Little structure comes from outside, and you supply the rest from your own will.
function.definition_friction: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Earth makes it settled, a frame that stays put. As a friction, the frame closes in. You need to stand right with the rules, and that leaves you little space of your own.
function.definition_balanced: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Earth makes it steady, a rule that stays once you agree. In balance, the frame holds without closing in. You keep the rules you chose and stand easy inside them.
function.advise_catalyst: You carry every line you live by alone, since few deadlines come to you from outside. Put yourself under one. Sign up for the race, the exam or the course with a date on it. Hold one fixed hour each week for it and do not move it.
function.advise_friction: Seek Metal, the Mind energy. Metal is the clear line that sorts a demand into what is asked and what is feared. Let it hold what Earth presses on you. You take each demand as a judgement on yourself. Cut one task this week that nobody asked you for. Ask what is needed, then do that much and stop.

candidates.cta_verdict: You keep a rule best when you feel its weight rather than read it, and a demand with pressure behind it usually gets your fullest answer.

catalyst.clause: the water has no banks to push against
catalyst.remedy: Answer to one deadline you did not set, and keep it.

friction.clause: the banks press in until the water barely moves
friction.remedy: Read one slow book before the next demand.

wide.clause: You were given plenty of Earth, the ground that gives your water a path.
wide.remedy: Use the banks. Take on one hard deadline and meet it.

missing.clause: No bank anywhere, and the water goes wherever the ground tips and settles nowhere.
missing.remedy: Borrow Earth from someone above you, and a date you cannot move.

spared.clause: No Earth presses on the water here, and the current keeps its own depth.
spared.remedy: Leave it absent. Set your own pace and keep it.

thin.clause: Only a little Earth touches the water, a low bank the current clears with ease.
thin.remedy: Keep it that small. Answer to few rules, chosen by you.

excess.clause: Earth piles onto the water until the river chokes on mud and stops moving.
excess.remedy: Clear the mud. Drop two duties, keep one, and rest.

catalyst.clause: Nothing catches you: rain spreading wide and soaking in nowhere, freedom without force.

friction.clause: The gutters take it all: rain routed into a schedule until it forgets where it wanted to fall.

wide.clause: You are well supplied with Earth, the ground that turns rain into a harvest.
wide.remedy: Keep the role you have. Let it aim you.

mechanism_yin.base: The solid prevails over the flowing, and so earth contains water: banks make the stream, walls make the well, and rain without a vessel is only weather. Contained, rain becomes current, direction, force. The old texts do not call the banks a prison. They call them the reason the stream arrives.
mechanism_yin.catalyst_turn: Run thin, nothing catches you: rain spreading wide and soaking in nowhere, freedom without force. Your chart asks for structure. Accept the role, the rhythm, the walls that aim you.
mechanism_yin.friction_turn: Run heavy, the gutters take it all: rain routed into a schedule until it forgets where it wanted to fall. Widen the channel. Rain is meant to wander.

__ore.retired_fn_body: The Duty is your accountability function: how order, obligation, and firm structure sit on you. With Earth running it, accountability in you is banked and patient: steady roles, long commitments, people whose expectations do not move with weather. You resent the walls and run truer inside them, and both facts belong in your planning. Choose banks that point somewhere worth arriving.
__ore.retired_base_personal: Your core is Water, and Earth tames Water: banks give the river its path. Earth is the structure that contains you, schedules, roles, walls that will not move for feeling, and contained water is what a river is. That is why Earth is your Order, the discipline that shapes you. Unbanked, depth spreads into marsh. Banked, it becomes current.

backlog_dips_tg_pattern.action: Structure converts you to force: the same depth that idles in the open drives turbines in a channel.

__ore.retired_v3_definition_catalyst:
Earth is your Order, and as a catalyst, it is the structure that turns your depth into force: fixed roles, steady schedules, commitments that do not move with your moods. You are most creative inside walls you chose.

Freeform by temperament, best in a frame. The standing deadline produced more than the free year did, the fixed morning routine made the afternoons deeper, and every fertile period of your life had a rhythm someone could set a clock by.

Choose your structure and the rest takes care of itself. Anchor the week with three fixed blocks, same day, same hour, and let everything fluid arrange around them. Accept the role with the schedule. Keep the routine two weeks past the urge to quit.
__ore.retired_v3_definition_friction:
Earth is your Order, and as a friction, it is structure tightening past usefulness: a calendar with no slack, roles held from duty long after they stopped fitting, routine squeezing out the responsiveness you actually run on.

Reliable, scheduled, subtly suffocating. Every hour is spoken for, the role fits like a uniform two sizes small, and the spontaneity that used to be your intelligence now needs an appointment.

A schedule should hold your life, never replace it. Leave one afternoon a week unscheduled and guard the emptiness. Renegotiate the obligation you dread most. Each quarter, drop one commitment that survives on habit alone.
